subject: Customer: delayed final-chunk + heartbeat mismatch — needs exec attention
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluegate.ai>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: support@bluegate.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: live inference feed — repeated long final-chunk delays (trial)

Hi Sergio,

We're seeing a problem in our trial where session streams are returning the bulk of tokens quickly, then stalling for 6–12s before the final chunk (or closing chunk) arrives. This shows up as: higher tail latency (p99 ~ 12s vs baseline 0.8s), intermittent 502/504 on closed connections, and a spike in client-side reattempts. The behaviour started around 02/17 08:45 PST.

Attached: capture-20280217-ws-logs.txt and a short trace. We've instrumented a small repro that uses our multiplexed websocket client; when the stall happens the server logs show a heartbeat mismatch on the same worker and then a proxy 504 on the edge.

Impact: evaluation endpoints are reporting higher error rates (3.4% customer-visible), and our UX team reports cancellations during the last-second waits. Renewal decision meeting next week — this is high priority.

Can you confirm this is on Redwood infra side or our integration? We can provide more traces or flip to a non-multiplexed test client if that helps.

— Emily
Emily Chen
Platform Lead, BlueGate AI


From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluegate.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 09:42:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: live inference feed — repeated long final-chunk delays (trial)

Emily — thanks for the quick report and the artifacts. I pulled the logs you attached. Summary of what I'm seeing on first pass:

- Repro window aligns with our edge proxy scaling event at 08:43 PST; several requests routed through a new proxy instance.
- Worker-side traces show normal token decode times until the final flush; then a queueing delay (~6–9s) before the last write.
- Heartbeat discrepancy: edge reported last-ack from worker at T, worker reported connection open but unack'd for ~7s.
- Errors cluster at higher concurrency (your trial had ~300 concurrent sessions) — throughput boundary appears to be exposing a race in our write coalescing path.

Immediate asks: can you run the non-multiplexed client for 30 minutes and send the new trace? That will help separate client multiplexing interactions from server coalesce behavior. I'm copying infra (Marissa) and runtime (Karthik) to triage.

I'll escalate if we confirm it's on our side and needs a mitigation that impacts capacity.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: live inference feed — repeated long final-chunk delays (trial)

Short triage notes (runtime/infra):

- Root cause hypothesis: write coalescer + proxy health check interplay. When the coalescer batches a trailing chunk and proxy rebalances sessions mid-flush we hit an edge case where flush is postponed while the proxy awaits instance readiness -> final-chunk delay.
- Repro: confirmed locally with a stress harness at ~300 concurrent streams and forced proxy rotation.
- Mitigations: 1) immediate config change at edge to prefer in-flight flush affinity (hotfix), 2) runtime change to reduce trailing-chunk coalescing window from 50ms -> 5ms (quick patch), 3) longer-term: explicit flush-on-last-token signal for multiplexed clients.

Impact/ask for execs: if we enable hotfix (1) it will trigger a brief re-route (few minutes) and may reduce overall throughput by ~6% during high concurrency windows — customer-facing but preserves tail latency. If BlueGate is sensitive to throughput drop we should offer a credit and plan a rollback path.

I'm attaching a short repro trace (bluegate_trace-20280217.json) and a sample log extract showing the delayed flush.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Serving Runtime, Redwood Inference
From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@bluegate.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 18 Feb 2028 17:45:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: live inference feed — delayed final-chunk + heartbeat mismatch — executive ask and immediate plan

Emily — update and next steps. Thank you for the repro traces; we confirmed the issue is in our write-coalescing + edge rebalancer interaction. Outline below and asks for the renewal thread.

What we found:
- The delays are caused when sessions are moved between edge proxy instances while a trailing token batch is buffered. The proxy can delay the final write while it completes handoff, which manifests as a 4–12s final-chunk gap.
- The behavior is more likely at concurrency >250 and during autoscale events. BlueGate's trial spiked concurrency which exposed the window.

Immediate actions (next 24 hours):
1) Enable edge hotfix: prefer affinity for connections with in-flight flushes (will deploy at 21:00 PST tonight). Risk: brief re-route and ~6% available throughput reduction under max load.
2) Backfill customers on affected windows with a one-time usage credit for the trial period (we propose 10% credit against trial overages).
3) Ship runtime quick patch to reduce the trailing-chunk coalesce window (will be released to staging tomorrow).
4) Longer-term: protocol-level last-token flush signal for multiplexed websocket clients (tracked INF-4821).

Ask of BlueGate for executive-level communication: we want to confirm we can proceed with the hotfix tonight and grant a one-time credit. If yes, we'll schedule a 30-minute maintenance window and a short post-deploy health call.

Attachments: bluegate_malp-report.pdf (concise summary for BlueGate execs).

If you prefer a live 15–20 minute bridge with our CTO and your platform exec before we flip the hotfix, we'll arrange it immediately.

— Sergio
